title: Cumulative OpenAPI Hits by Endpoint
description: Total GET requests made to api.data.gov.my, disaggregated by endpoint.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.title: Endpoint
fields.description: [String] The endpoint being requested; full documentation of available endpoints is available via the [Developer Portal](https://developer.data.gov.my/)

fields.name: hits
fields.title: Hits (count)
fields.description: [Integer] Number of requests made to the specific endpoint

fields.name: hits_prop
fields.title: Hits (%)
fields.description: [Float] Number of requests made to the specific endpoint, as a percentage of total hits

methodology: This data is aggregated from transactional records produced by web analytics tools which monitor user interactions across the data.gov.my platform in real time. The data does not contain any personally identifiable information, as there is no component of data.gov.my which requires an authenticated login to access.
caveat: Although the OpenAPI was live from 13 Sep 2023, this dataset only includes API hits from 15 Dec 2023 onwards due to lack of disaggregated usage data prior to that date.
